players: 8-10 (numbers below are for 8; '+1/+2' says what to add)
equipment: Cones (4 colours) to mark the lanes
theme: The rotation chain: FB in, 8 out, winger in
focus: In possession: when the 8 goes wide, the winger goes inside to keep two per lane, trap their full-back and set up the reverse pass and the ladder
objectives: Complete the 3-player chain (FB in, 8 out, W in) with the right timing
Read the opposition: if their CM follows the 8, play the diagonal into the W; if their FB jumps to the 8, play the reverse pass behind for the W against their CB
Use the ladder (8 to 9, 9 sets first time, W runs in behind) to get in behind
key_messages: "8 out, W in" - the winger's trigger is the 8 leaving the half-space
"Who follows?" - make their FB, CB or CM decide
"Reverse it" - the pass in behind their jumping FB

blocks.title: Ladder passing pattern with rotation

diagram.caption: x2 groups of 4 (or 5). 8 plays into 9, 9 sets back first time, W runs in behind for the through ball. Everyone rotates one position.

blocks.setup: Two 30x20m areas side by side. 8 players: 2 groups of 4 (8, 9, W + 1 waiting at the 8 cone). 9-10: groups of 4 and 5. Start cones for the 8 (yellow), 9 (orange), W (blue), finish cone (red).
how: 8 plays into the 9's feet and follows the pass to support underneath.
9 sets first time back to the 8 (round the corner).
W times the run off the 9's set and receives the through ball, then dribbles over the red cone.
Rotation: 8 to 9, 9 to W, W back to the 8 cone. Next ball goes as soon as the W is away.
After 5 minutes: the waiting player becomes a passive defender on the 9.
blocks.link_to_theme: Grooves the ladder combination and the habit of rotating into a new position.
coaching_points: 9 sets with an angled stick so the ball arrives on the 8's open side
W starts the run as the 9 sets, not when the 8 receives
8 plays the through ball on the first or second touch, weighted into the W's path
progressions: 9 can choose to set or turn (passive defender decides it)
blocks.activity_notes: Groups of 4-5 with a new ball every 15 seconds: each player works every 15-20 seconds.

blocks.title: The 3-player chain: read who follows

diagram.caption: LB has the ball inside, 8 goes wide, W comes inside. Their CM, FB and CB must choose who to follow. Score through the end gates.

blocks.setup: 45x33m, 3 lanes. 8 players: blue LCB, LB, 8, LW, 9 v red CM, FB, CB. Two gates on the end line: centre gate (red cones) and half-space gate (blue cones). 9: add a red second CB. 10: add a red W who presses the LCB and a blue 6.
how: LCB plays into the LB, who starts inside in the half-space (the Week 1 position). As the ball travels, the 8 drifts wide and the LW comes inside.
Read 1 - their CM follows the 8: LB plays the diagonal into the LW coming inside.
Read 2 - their CM stays: LB plays out to the 8 wide. If their FB jumps to the 8, the 8 plays the reverse pass in behind for the LW against their CB.
Read 3 - nothing on behind: ladder - 8 into 9, 9 sets, LW runs in behind.
Blue score by dribbling through either gate. First 6 minutes coach tells red what to do; then red go live at 75%. Swap 3 blue into red every 4 minutes.
blocks.link_to_theme: Builds the whole chain from the video and the decisions it forces on the opposition, with the exact players who make it happen.
coaching_points: Timing: the W only goes inside once the 8 has started going wide - too early and their FB just passes him on
LW comes inside on the blind side of their FB, then shows on the open stick side for the diagonal
8 wide: receive across the body facing forward so the reverse pass is a single action
Reverse pass is weighted into the space between their FB and CB, not to the W's stick
questions: Their FB jumped to our 8: where is the space now?
Their CM followed our 8 out: who is free?
progressions: Red CM and FB fully live from the start
regressions: Coach calls the read (1, 2 or 3) as the ball goes in
blocks.activity_notes: All 8-10 involved each rep; reps reset every 15-20 seconds from the LCB.

blocks.title: 5v3 to goal: rotation and counter

diagram.caption: Blue 5 attack 2 mini goals on the end line. Red 3 defend and counter into 2 mini goals behind the LCB. Goal from the reverse pass or ladder = 2.

blocks.setup: 45x33m, 3 lanes. 2 mini goals on the end line for blue, 2 behind the start line for red. 8 players: blue 5 (LCB, LB, 8, LW, 9) v red 3 (CM, FB, CB). 9: red +1 CB (5v4). 10: blue +1 (a 6), red +1 W (6v5). Swap roles every 4 minutes.
how: Every rep starts with a coach feed into the LCB.
Blue score in either end mini goal: 1 goal, or 2 if it came from the reverse pass or the ladder.
Red win it: score in either mini goal behind the LCB within 6 seconds.
First 10 minutes build down the left, then flip the cones and build down the right.
blocks.link_to_theme: The chain against live opposition who are trying to stop it, with a reward for the two key finishes.
coaching_points: Make them decide: hold the wide and half-space positions long enough that their FB has to choose
Ball speed after the rotation - the advantage lasts about 2 seconds
9 stays high to pin their CB until the ladder is on, then drops to set
Rest-defence: the LCB stays connected to stop the counter
regressions: Red FB must stay in the wide lane
Red counter only by dribbling, not passing
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone plays; coach has 10 balls at the start line so the next rep starts as soon as one ends.

step.task: Count rotations completed as well as goals
step.people: Fittest group plays red so blue face proper pressure

blocks.title: 4v4 (+ floaters): who follows? game

diagram.caption: 4v4 + floater 9. 2 mini goals each end. Goal from the diagonal into an inside W, the reverse pass or the ladder = 2.

blocks.setup: 50x40m, 3 lanes, 2 mini goals at each end. 8 players: 4v4 (CB, FB, 8, W each). 9: 1 neutral floater who plays as the 9 for the team in possession. 10: 5v5 with a 9 each.
how: Restarts are always from the team's CB on their own goal line.
Goal from the diagonal into an inside W, the reverse pass or the ladder = 2.
Coach freeze once every 4 minutes on a good or missed rotation (30 seconds max).
Play 4 x 4-minute games with 1 minute rest. Last game: no bonus, see if it sticks.
blocks.link_to_theme: Puts the chain into a full-intensity game with transitions, so timing and recognition are tested under fatigue.
coaching_points: Recognise the picture in the game - it won't look as tidy as the drill
If the chain breaks, re-form two per lane before forcing it
Whoever isn't in the chain pushes up to make it a 2v1 or 3v2 when the reverse pass goes
progressions: Bonus only if the rotation happens on the weaker side
regressions: Floater plays even at 8 (rotate the role every game)
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone plays; ball-stocks behind both ends for instant restarts.

blocks.title: 4v4 / 5v5 on the half pitch: run the chain
blocks.setup: Half pitch, full goal at one end (GK if one trains, otherwise 2 mini goals), 2 mini goals on halfway. 4v4, 4v4+1 or 5v5. Swap ends at 10 minutes.
how: Normal game.
Focus: when the 8 goes wide, the winger goes inside - every time.
Coach tallies completed rotation chains and entries in behind that came from them.
coaching_points: Timing of the winger's inside run
The reverse pass in behind their FB
Week 1 still applies - two in every lane on the ball side
questions: Who did their full-back follow? What did that open up?

safety: Shin guards and gum shields for all
Reverse passes on the floor - no raised balls in blocks 1-4
If a GK trains, they must be fully kitted before going in goal
reflection_prompts: Was the winger's timing right, or did they go inside too early?
Which read (follow / stay / jump) did players spot most easily?
Which players need the chain walked through again before Week 3?
